message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference table of the **federal public holidays** in Canada for 2023 that create a *long weekend* (i.e., a three‑day weekend).  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the “observed” date is shown in parentheses.)

| Holiday | Calendar Date | Day of Week | Observed (if applicable) | Creates a Long Weekend? | Notes |
|---------|---------------|-------------|--------------------------|------------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 2023 | Sunday | Mon Jan 2 | ❌ | Observed on Monday, but still a 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| Family Day (BC, AB, ON, SK, NB, PE) | Feb 20 2023 | Monday | — | ✅ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon). |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 2023 | Friday | — | ✅ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Thu‑Fri‑Sat). |
| Victoria Day | May 22 2023 | Monday | — | ✅ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon). |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 2023 | Saturday | Mon Jul 3 | ❌ | Observed on Monday, but still a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon). |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 2023 | Monday | — | ✅ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon). |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 2023 | Monday | — | ✅ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon). |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 2023 | Monday | — | ✅ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon). |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 2023 | Monday | — | ✅ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon). |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 2023 | Tuesday | — | ❌ | Combined with Christmas it gives a 4‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon). |

### Quick Takeaway
- **Long weekends** (3 days): Family Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day.  
- **Extended weekend** (4 days): Christmas + Boxing Day (Fri‑Mon).  
- **Observed holidays**: New Year’s Day (obs. Mon Jan 2) and Canada Day (obs. Mon Jul 3) still give a 3‑day weekend because the weekend itself is part of the break.

> **Tip for your app:** If you’re building a calendar feature, consider marking the *observed* dates for holidays that fall on weekends so users see the actual day off.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the same information broken down by province (e.g., Civic Holiday in Ontario, Family Day in Manitoba, etc.) or if you need the dates for a different year!
